title: Kit manifest
description: What one kit holds, at <layer>/kit.json for a layer kit and schema/kit.json for the system kit (EE-018): its skills, the record types it owns, the record types it reads and writes, and the checks that run on them. A kit offered as a product points at its product card. Layer relationships are derived from reads and writes, never written by hand. schema/check-data-model.mjs checks it.

purpose.description: What the layer is for, in one sentence

product.description: The product card that offers this kit, as <venture id>/<product id>

path.description: The SKILL.md, from the repo root

tier.description: Optional: the MAD tier a skill serves, for a venture that uses MAD (a separate product since EE-038)

standalone.description: Useful without the rest of the kit

move_to.description: A proposed owning kit, when the skill is filed in the wrong layer

records.description: Record types this kit owns (data-model ids)

reads.description: Record types of other kits its skills and checks read today

writes.description: Record types of other kits its skills write today

checks.description: Scripts that check or run this kit's records, from the repo root
